name: DAU — active libraries today (UTC)
description: Explicit event contract. Distinct central-library IDs are a user proxy; opt-outs are excluded. Website IDs remain separate. Data appears after release.

source.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS active_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND properties.qualifying_activity = true AND event IN ('content_changed','session_created','message_submitted') AND timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) AND timestamp < now()

name: WAU — active libraries, rolling 7 days
description: Explicit event contract. Distinct central-library IDs are a user proxy; opt-outs are excluded. Website IDs remain separate. Data appears after release.

source.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS active_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND properties.qualifying_activity = true AND event IN ('content_changed','session_created','message_submitted') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND timestamp < now()

name: MAU — active libraries, rolling 30 days
description: Explicit event contract. Distinct central-library IDs are a user proxy; opt-outs are excluded. Website IDs remain separate. Data appears after release.

source.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS active_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND properties.qualifying_activity = true AND event IN ('content_changed','session_created','message_submitted') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND timestamp < now()

name: Daily active libraries — 30 day trend
description: Explicit event contract. Distinct central-library IDs are a user proxy; opt-outs are excluded. Website IDs remain separate. Data appears after release.

source.query: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS active_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND properties.qualifying_activity = true AND event IN ('content_changed','session_created','message_submitted') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND timestamp < now() GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

name: App opens and opening libraries — daily
description: First interface opening per process after disclosure, grouped by UTC day. Reopening pages and background services do not add opens. Opening libraries are distinct shared library IDs, separate from qualified actives.

source.query: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, count(DISTINCT uuid) AS opens, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS opening_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND event = 'app_opened' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND timestamp < now() GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

name: Qualified activity by feature — 30 days
description: Explicit event contract. Distinct central-library IDs are a user proxy; opt-outs are excluded. Website IDs remain separate. Data appears after release.

source.query: SELECT event, properties.item_category AS category, count() AS actions FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND properties.qualifying_activity = true AND event IN ('content_changed','session_created','message_submitted') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY event,category ORDER BY actions DESC

name: Active libraries by country — 30 days
description: Explicit event contract. Distinct central-library IDs are a user proxy; opt-outs are excluded. Website IDs remain separate. Data appears after release.

source.query: SELECT properties.$geoip_country_code AS country, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS active_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND properties.qualifying_activity = true AND event IN ('content_changed','session_created','message_submitted') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY country ORDER BY active_libraries DESC

name: Website visitors and conversions — 30 days
description: Explicit event contract. Distinct central-library IDs are a user proxy; opt-outs are excluded. Website IDs remain separate. Data appears after release.

source.query: SELECT event, count() AS events, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS browsers FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'website' AND event IN ('$pageview','download_clicked','download_redirected','github_clicked') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY event ORDER BY events DESC

name: In-app update stages — 30 days
description: Clicks, verified fresh downloads, and replacement-app launches by target version. Cache reuse is excluded from completed downloads. Stages overlap and are never added to GitHub totals or qualified actives. Empty until the analytics release ships.

source.query: SELECT event AS update_stage, properties.target_version AS target_version, count(DISTINCT uuid) AS events, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND event IN ('update_check_clicked','update_download_clicked','update_download_completed','update_download_failed','update_install_clicked','update_install_completed','update_install_failed') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND timestamp < now() GROUP BY update_stage, target_version ORDER BY target_version, update_stage
